ltv_slabs._note: SBI DIFFERS: only TWO slabs, boundary at Rs 20L (not 30L/75L like HDFC/ICICI). NO 75% slab - stays 80% even above 75L. On property, SBI lends more than private banks. LTV on assessed value.

retirement_age._note: Max age at maturity 70 for ALL borrowers - SBI does not split salaried/self-employed. Most generous of the three (HDFC 60/65, ICICI 65/70). Older borrowers get most tenure at SBI.

min_cibil._source: SBI official eligibility page states NONE. Aggregator (mymudra.com) claims 650 floor - LOW TIER, unverified.
min_cibil._note: SBI's own page publishes no CIBIL minimum. Aggregator table (650 floor, 700+ good) is a third-party DSA site's inference, NOT SBI policy - do not trust as fact. DSA-gated: confirm SBI's real internal cutoff.

processing_fee._note: Tiered: 0.25% for <=25L, then flat Rs10,000 (25-75L), flat Rs20,000 (>75L). Much cheaper than HDFC/ICICI on mid-size loans. From MITC.

rate_band._note: Home Loan (TL) standard rate 7.25-8.55%, EBLR-linked (EBLR=7.90%). Floating only, daily reducing balance. +10bps premium for non-salaried with CIBIL <825. LOWEST prime rate of the three lenders (SBI 7.25 vs HDFC 7.75 vs ICICI 8.50). PSU - cheaper on rate but typically slower/stricter approval.
rate_band._source: SBI home loan interest rate page (sbi.bank.in)

foir_by_income_band._note: FOIR cap varies by income - proprietary, DSA-gated

salaried: 3 months salary slip or salary certificate
1 year loan statement if existing loans
accepted_income_proofs._note: SBI does NOT split self-employed into prof/non-prof (calls all 'Non-Salaried'); prof/non-prof rows here are near-identical, differing only by the professional qualification cert. SBI requires 3 yrs ITR+financials for self-employed (vs HDFC/ICICI's 2). KYC waived for existing SBI KYC-compliant account holders - relationship advantage.

co_applicant_clubbing._note: Key remediation lever for FOIR-bound buyers. Clubbing spouse/parent income raises FOIR base. Haircut % and allowed relationships are lender-specific - DSA-gated. Co-applicant's own EMIs usually also clubbed.
